stem:
The table shows the relationship between the numbers of soft pretzels customers bought at a store and the total cost of the pretzels in dollars.

Soft Pretzels

| Number of Soft Pretzels, x | Total Cost, y (dollars) |
|-----------------------------|------------------------|
| 1                           | 3.50                   |
| 2                           | 7.00                   |
| 3                           | 10.50                  |
| 4                           | 14.00                  |

Which graph best represents the data from the table?

options.label: F
options.text: Graph labeled F showing points clustered around (4,1), (8,2), (12,3), (15,4)

options.label: H
options.text: Graph labeled H showing points clustered around (4,1), (7,2), (11,3), (14,4)

options.label: G
options.text: Graph labeled G showing points at (1,4), (2,7), (3,11), (4,14)

options.label: J
options.text: Graph labeled J showing points at (1,3.5), (2,7), (3,10.5), (4,14)

visual_elements: Table of Number of Soft Pretzels vs Total Cost
Four graphs labeled F, H, G, and J with plotted points
notes: Graph J best matches the data points in the table exactly.
